episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: After a spectacular fall from grace, high-flying heart surgeon Dr Hugh Knight is forced to work as a country GP in his former home town of Whyhope. Meanwhile, his ex-girlfriend vows to send him packing.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Hugh has a shocking introduction to outback medicine when he attends a farm accident. Inspired by Meryl's dodgy dealings, Hugh blackmails mine boss Big Nathan into making a huge donation to the Hospital.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Hugh finds an unlikely test subject for his revolutionary new artificial heart. Passions are aroused when Charlie and Matt host a wild B&S Ball at their Brewery.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Hugh makes an emergency visit to the city to salvage his career, and learns a family secret that will change his life forever. Charlies frustration with Meryl's meddling reaches crisis point, and she takes sweet revenge.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Hugh becomes the town hero after footage goes viral of him saving a promising young footballer from a booby trapped paddock, but is quickly brought back down to reality.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Hugh offends everyone in Whyhope as he desperately tries to hide his secret past. Meryl launches a charm offensive to help Charlie deal with her pregnancy grief.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Hugh and Penny are forced together during an overnight trip to a coal mine. Meryl turns failure into success when she unveils a new statue to commemorate the town. Aoife confesses her love for Hugh.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Hugh decides to tell Ajax the truth about their relationship, against Jim's advice. Meryl forces her family to support her campaign for Mayor.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Hugh faces a dilemma when his best friend Joey makes a dying wish. The Knight family rallies to support Ajax and Meryl as they each confront a major crisis.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Hugh is shocked when he finds out Penny accepts a job in the city and the hospital is thrown into chaos. Charlie develops an unhealthy obsession over Hugh's relationship with Penny.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Hugh is facing his biggest crisis yet when his love life, career and family are all in desperate need of a help. Charlie plays dirty to win back Matt, while Meryl's election as town Mayor is overshadowed by fraud.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Hugh and the hospital staff use blackmail to get rid of their incompetent boss, Nora. Meanwhile, Penny faces family and romantic dilemmas that will change her future. Hayley struggles with a guilty conscience over her relationship with Ajax.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Hugh creates havoc for Charlie when he reveals her secret talent. Penny's first day back in Whyhope is headed for disaster until she joins forces with Hugh. Hayley makes a fateful decision to fix Meryl's election fraud problem.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Hugh comes to blows with Penny's new boyfriend, while Meryl plays dirty to win the re-count of the Mayoral election. Ajax gets a new perspective on life and death when he does work experience in the hospital.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Penny's sister causes havoc for Hugh and Ken when she visits Whyhope to defend Meryl against corruption charges. Betty uses her hidden talents to solve a medical mystery involving backpackers, sardines and farm machinery.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Penny makes an unexpected choice when Hugh and Toke turn up the romantic pressure. When Charlie is unfairly sacked by the Headmaster, Meryl resorts to blackmail to get her reinstated.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Hugh struggles to prove his innocence and win back Penny after failing a drug test. Meryl and Charlie lock horns over Hayley's entry in the Miss Whyhope competition. Ajax makes the worst decision of his life.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Hugh and Penny race to find a kidney donor to save Jim's life. Charlie is stalked by an obsessive fan, while Matt and Ajax hunt down a thief targeting their farm.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Hugh's estranged wife arrives from Las Vegas and creates chaos for Penny and Hugh's family. Charlie and Matt teach Hayley a lesson about love, lust and the need to forgive Ajax.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Penny is heartbroken when Hugh makes a series of disastrous choices about his marriage and career. Love is in the air on Hayley and Ajax's wedding day.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Disgraced heart surgeon Dr Hugh Knight's plans to leave Whyhope forever are upended when tragedy strikes. Penny makes a fateful decision about her love-life.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Hugh faces chaos at home and work, with a mutiny on the farm and a deadly pregnancy crisis with Hayley. Meryl teaches Matt and Charlie a lesson about bribery and corruption.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The grand opening of Hugh's new Cardiac Clinic is upset by life-changing news from his ex-wife. Charlie's life is thrown into disarray when her father makes a surprise visit.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Meryl and Carlito's relationship sends shockwaves through the Knight family. Tension between Hugh and Penny puts the new cardiac clinic at risk. Matt reconnects with his old high school crush.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Penny's personal feelings for Hugh spill over into the workplace, with embarrassing results. Charlie and Matt struggle to deal with an unwanted house guest. A high-profile cardiac patient causes problems for Ken and Hugh.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: When her life starts to unravel, Penny delivers Hugh an ultimatum about their relationship. Meryl and Betty enlist Hugh as their star attraction at the first Whyhope Speed Dating night. Matt and Charlie's relationship reaches a crisis point

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Matt and Charlie's marriage is tested when they disagree over Ivy's future. Hugh's plan to leave Whyhope is delayed when he is accused of malpractice. Ajax and Meryl devise a bizarre plan to save the farm from bankruptcy.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Ajax takes drastic action to prevent Hugh selling the farm. Penny finds her perfect match thanks to Meryl's dating service. Matt drowns his sorrows with April.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Hugh tries to cancel the farm sale when he learns the identity of the new owner. Matt is torn between his feelings for Charlie and April. Meryl uncovers major corruption in the local council.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Hugh's world is rocked after Harriet gives birth to their baby. Penny makes a fateful choice about her future with Hugh. Meryl and Ajax go to war over his plans for a cemetery on the family farm.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Hugh becomes distracted from his new daughter Eliza and his Cardiac Unit by the arrival of sexy new doctor, Tara.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Hugh reaches crisis point when Penny fires him from the hospital; Hayley is inspired to perk up her sex life after reading Charlie's erotic sci-fi novel.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Hugh and Jarrod lock horns over Penny, with painful results for Jarrod. Ajax vows revenge after Meryl humiliates him in a council election scam. Matt risks his relationship with April when he asks Charlie to help to run the brewery.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Hugh finally gets the courage to declare his love to Penny; Hayley is torn between love and duty when Ajax and Meryl compete in the council election; April gives Charlie an ultimatum to leave Whyhope and forget about Matt.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: While Penny is away, Hugh and Tara come out to play, and with a little help from Charlie their night takes a dramatic turn as Hugh loses more than his sobriety.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: April is pregnant, and not everyone is as supportive as Matt had hoped, but the netball game between the hospital and mining company takes all the focus.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Hugh agrees to help Tara with a random drug test, but an indiscretion puts their relationship out into the open. With April gone, Charlie offers to help out at the brewery, and Betty raises suspicions to Penny about Jarrod's dodgy dealings.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: It's Hugh's birthday, but when Tara doesn't show up for work, Hugh finds her unconscious in her home. As the hospital team races to save her life, Tara's parents arrive and raise awkward questions about their daughter's party antics.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Hugh's friends try to help him after his embarrassing outburst at his birthday party, while Meryl's health suffers after losing all her allies. Hayley continues her pole-dancing classes, despite Ajax's wishes, but tensions explode when she starts working at the new bar.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Penny narrowly survives the car crash but is forced to stay at the hospital to recuperate. When Jarrod gets a job offer out of town, Penny must decide whether or not to leave Whyhope — and Hugh — for good.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Hugh's plan to leave Whyhope is thrown into chaos when the hospital is forced to shut, Meryl is investigated for corruption, and an old flame makes a surprise return.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Hugh and Penny set aside their differences to fight for the rights of a terminally ill young mother; as she faces criminal charges, Meryl ropes in Hayley to hide evidence of her corruption from Sharna.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Hugh and Penny lock horns when she returns to work at the hospital. Sharna's mission to clean up Whyhope causes chaos for Ken, Betty and Meryl.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Hugh's romance with Sharna hits a rocky patch when she threatens to shut down the hospital. Charlie devises a plan to solve Meryl's legal problems and help Wes's family.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Hugh is forced to choose sides when Meryl plots to destroy Sharna's career. Ken reveals a dark secret when his parents visit Whyhope. Hayley has a crisis of faith when she breaks all ten commandments in one day.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Penny must decide between her loyalty to the hospital and her feelings for Hugh. Meryl's corruption trial takes a surprising twist, and Ajax takes a stand to win back Hayley.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Penny's teenage son hatches a cunning plan to rekindle the romance between Hugh and Penny. Sharna launches a charm offensive to get Hugh a high-profile job in the city. Meryl and Michael's romance faces a major roadblock.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Hugh faces his biggest decision ever – can he leave Whyhope and Penny for a new life in the city? Meanwhile, love comes to the Knight family when Meryl, Matt and Ajax all find new reasons to fall in love again.
